display_long_description:
You wake up in Dr Docto's lab. He wants to see what an octopus can do. Show him. Swing around your tank, wreck his desk, flush yourself down the toilet and fight your way out through 10 levels of his worst experiments.

# 🦑  Your Arms Are the Tentacles
Reach out and stick to anything. Grab walls, swing from pipes, fling yourself across the room and climb straight up the glass. Once it clicks, nothing else moves like it.
[media]

# ✋  Grab Everything
Pick up shells, rocks, hammers, potions, fish and Dr Docto's stuff. If it isn't bolted down, it's yours.

[media]

# 💥  Cause Chaos in the Lab
Get out of the water and onto the scientist's desk. Knock things off shelves, smash glass and make a mess of his experiments.

# 🚽 Escape the Toilet Pipe
Race down a giant toilet pipe while a drill chases you from behind. How far can you get? Post your best distance on the leaderboard.

[media]

# 🌋  Outrun the Lava
In Lava Lands the floor really is lava, and it's rising. Launch, jump and fly through the obstacles before it catches you.

# 🚀  Weapons and Gadgets
Rocket launchers, jetpack, hammers, jet skis, bubble guns, bombs and more!

[media]

# 🎨  Unlock New Tentacle Skins
Complete achievements to earn new tentacles: metal, rainbow, lava and cameo are only the beginning. Make your octopus your own

[media]

# 💬 JOIN OUR DISCORD
https://discord.gg/qaHH4hZn7c
